name: szfp8-tax-seo-cloudflare
description: SonicJS tax and invoice SEO site for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: echo 'Cloudflare Workers build is handled by Wrangler'
scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB

DB.description: Required D1 database. Cloudflare will automatically create and bind it during Deploy to Cloudflare.

MEDIA_BUCKET.description: Required R2 bucket for SonicJS media uploads. Cloudflare will automatically create and bind it during Deploy to Cloudflare.
